rows.text: with `u` = `[rdx]` - `[rcx]` and `v` = `[r8]` - `[rdx]` (4-float lanes, aligned loads), forms the cross product `n` = `u` x `v` by four shuffles (lane orders z,x,y,w and y,z,x,w of `u` and of `v`), two multiplies and a subtract (fourth lane: `u.w`*`v.w` minus the same product), takes `s` = `n.x`^2 + `n.y`^2 + `n.z`^2 (mask 1,1,1,0 and two horizontal adds), refines `r` = `rsqrtps`(`s`) once as (3 - `s`*`r`*`r`) * (0.5*`r`), and stores (`n.x`*`r`, `n.y`*`r`, `n.z`*`r`, `n.w`) as 16 aligned bytes to `[r9]`; returns nothing

corrections.why: byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: the cross product uses four `shufps` (0xD2 and 0xC9 on each of `u` and `v`), two `mulps` and one `subps`; 'two shuffles, a multiply each' miscounts the shuffles
